text:
ida: Heads-up — onboarding odin-8b (int8) in canary. Hitting intermittent OOMs on coldstart during a burst of small requests. stack snippet: `OOM: allocation failed at kv_cache::reserve(32768)`

josh: Which batch / max_new_tokens defaults are you using? also prefetch on/off?

ida: Current canary config pasted below. Repro is pretty consistent with 40-60 concurrent short chat requests.

ida: ```
model: odin-8b-int8
batch:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
  max_batch_size: 8
runtime:
  kv_prefetch: true
  eviction_threshold: 0.6
  slot_reserve: 0.05
prompt:
  max_new_tokens: 128
```

priya: Try kv_prefetch=false for cold starts — we saw that reduce peak allocation spikes for other int8 models. Also drop max_new_tokens to 64 to shrink worst-case kv growth.

ken: Agree with priya. Also try soft microbatching: `max_batch_size: 4` + `slowstart: true` (ramp concurrency over 5s) — that avoids simultaneous kv allocations.

josh: Another lever: lower eviction_threshold to 0.45 temporarily so slot compactor triggers earlier. Might trade a bit more cache churn for fewer OOMs.

ida: Spun a canary with these changes: kv_prefetch=false, max_new_tokens=64, max_batch_size=4, eviction_threshold=0.45. runtime-bot shows deploy id `canary-odin-2026-03-21-09`.

runtime-bot: deploy canary-odin-2026-03-21-09 started — rolling 10% of traffic. initial 5m metrics: p95 latency +18%, OOM count dropped from 6 -> 1 per 10k reqs.

ida: Observed: OOMs much rarer (good), but p95 increased for short prompts (expected). Memory traces show fewer large contiguous allocations during coldstart.

priya: If p95 regress is unacceptable for the product, try a hybrid: pre-warm a tiny pool (reserved capacity 2 pods with warm KV) and keep kv_prefetch=false for autoscaled pods. That keeps cost low but gives fast path.

ken: Also consider enabling slot_compactor with aggressive immediate compaction on canary: `compaction_interval_ms: 200` and `compaction_aggressiveness: high` — just for the ephemeral experiment.

ida: Can run 2 more experiments: (A) microwarm: prewarm 2 pods + kv_prefetch=false on autoscale; (B) soft-prefetch: kv_prefetch=true but set `prefetch_batch_limit: 64` to cap allocations. Planning to run A overnight and B in the morning.

josh: Add perf/eval prompt set (10k short chats) and measure gen latency, token cost, and OOM rate. Also record per-route SLO impact.

ida: Will do. Action items: ida->run A/B experiments; priya->prepare prompt set and eval harness; ken->patch compactor flags for canary; josh->watch SLOs and cost delta.

slo-bot: alert created: canary-odin latency-regressions (watch p95) — alert id slo-4021.

ida: Thanks — will post results here when both experiments finish.

josh: TL;DR: For odin-8b int8 coldstart OOMs: prefer disabling prefetch, reduce max_new_tokens, cap batch size, and use micro-warm to recover latency when needed.
